Track pinned tool versions in workflow env vars

packageRules.description: Automerge everything short of a major when checks pass. PR checks are shellcheck + hadolint and PR builds are disabled, so this merges without an image build ever having run — the deliberate trade for zero dependency toil.
Keep first-party and base OCI images fresh immediately. The base namespaces are the three the Containerfile documents: Fedora, CentOS and Hummingbird.

Third-party GitHub Actions execute in workflows holding packages:write and the cosign OIDC signing identity (build-image.yml), so their bumps always wait for a human — an automerged compromised release would run there unreviewed. First-party projectbluefin/** actions stay automerged.

Hold the build runner at Ubuntu 24.04: projectbluefin/actions' setup-runner asserts ubuntu-24.04 when adding its resolute apt source, so 26.04 fails the build. Disable the major outright rather than filtering it with allowedVersions, whose range does not parse under the docker versioning a github-runner dep uses. Drop this once upstream supports 26.04.
A major crossing always waits for a human — never automerge one. Last matching rule wins, so keep this rule last.
